name: Tsumugi Trading
description: A calm, photograph-led theme for a mid-sized trading company: harbour ground, stone panels and ink text with a single kurumi (walnut-brown #947A6D) accent, Spectral over Hanken Grotesk. The home page opens with an inset full-bleed container-port photograph under a soft rounded corner, with a milestone-year line and a floating news card, then who we are with two photos, four business lines beside a sticky photograph, sixty years as a horizontal row of photographed milestones with large year numerals, three directors, sustainability, careers, news and contact. With Business, How we trade, Leadership, Sustainability, Careers, Company, Contact, Newsletter and News. Sample content in English, Traditional Chinese, Japanese, French and German.

summary.en: A calm trading-company theme: a container-port photograph with a milestone-year line, four business lines, sixty years in photographed milestones and three directors.
